literature.headline_zh: 禽流感病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期禽流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 我们检测到46/49个体中存在Pasteurella multocida DNA,并诊断为禽流感导致了这些动物的大部分死亡。 [10.1098/rspb.2026.1271]
在MDCK细胞中,表达禽类或1918年PB1的季节性人类H1N1病毒株可以在40°C下复制,而野生型H1N1病毒则不能。纯化嵌合IAV聚合酶的活性测定进一步表明,源自禽类的PB1可能在高温下内在性地增强聚合酶活性。 [10.1128/jvi.00978-26]
本回顾得出结论,H5N1 病毒已从家禽流行病转变为涉及多种宿主的泛流行病,包括野生动物、家养动物和人类。它强调了clade 2.3.4.4b 病毒在这一转变中的重要性,指出它们能够到达偏远生态系统并引起重要的哺乳动物暴发。特别强调了奶牛的出现,因为它对传播和人兽共患病的潜在影响。 [10.1007/s40471-026-00408-7]
2024年的三只北极熊和2025年的六只北极熊对高致病性禽流感(HPAI)有抗体,信号与噪音比值处于阳性范围内。2025年的六只北极熊中有四只对高致病性H5亚型2.3.4.4b病毒有抗体,表明近期暴露。 [10.3201/eid3211.261050]

literature.headline_en: Recent Avian influenza A viruses literature
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: We detected Pasteurella multocida DNA in 46 of 49 individuals, and diagnosed avian cholera as the cause of death of most of these animals. [10.1098/rspb.2026.1271]

Chimeric seasonal human H1N1 viruses expressing avian or 1918 PB1 replicate at 40°C in MDCK cells, unlike wild-type H1N1. Activity assays with purified chimeric IAV polymerases further suggest that avian-origin PB1 may intrinsically enhance polymerase activity at elevated temperatures. [10.1128/jvi.00978-26]

The review concludes that H5N1 viruses have transitioned from poultry epizootics to a panzootic involving multiple hosts, including wild birds, domestic animals, and humans. [10.1007/s40471-026-00408-7]

Three bears from 2024 and six bears from 2025 had antibodies to HPAI, with signal-to-noise values within the positive range. Four of the six 2025 bears had antibodies to the highly pathogenic H5 clade 2.3.4.4b, indicating recent exposure. [10.3201/eid3211.261050]
During 2021–2025, 22 of 1,523 samples (1.44%) met the threshold for H3N8, including 9 of 100 samples (9.00%) collected in Nanchang in the 2024 surveillance year. [10.1186/s12889-026-29921-6]

news.headline_zh: 禽流感病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期禽流感病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: WHO举办了题为'Understanding Influenza A(H9N2): current risks,One Health action and pandemic preparedness'的网络研讨会,以讨论禽流感 A(H9N2)的持续风险及其在动物-人类界面出现的可能性。该活动由WHO作为其健康紧急事件EPI-WIN计划的一部分进行报道。 [news-6836d697c95e8248]
西澳大利亚州政府发布了一则关于H5 禽流感(禽流感)的通知,强调报告病例的重要性并提供病毒相关信息。该事件被确认为公共卫生通知。 [news-c7a8114fd487046f]

papers.title: Avian cholera causes mass mortality at penguin mega-colonies amid H5N1 HPAI outbreaks in Antarctica
papers.abstract: Abstract The characterization of pathogens affecting Antarctic wildlife has been historically limited and sporadic. With the introduction of H5N1 high pathogenicity avian influenza virus (HPAIV) in Antarctica in the austral summer 2023/2024, concerns about the health of Antarctic seabirds and mammals prompted immediate surveillance efforts. In March 2024, we visited the Danger Islands archipelago, that hosts two mega-colonies of Adélie penguins, and observed an unusual mortality estimated in thousands of Adélie penguins and other species. Swabs and tissues were collected for molecular detection of infectious agents from 49 carcasses, and additional tissues for histology from a selection of 9 carcasses. We detected Pasteurella multocida DNA in 46 of 49 individuals, and diagnosed avian cholera as the cause of death of most of these animals. By shotgun sequencing, we retrieved the first genomic sequences of the P. multocida strain from this region, and the phylogenetic analysis showed a close relation with strains from other locations retrieved during the same expedition and with strains previously reported in the Southern Ocean area. This study confirms avian cholera as a relevant cause of mortality in the Antarctic, and overall highlights the importance of considering this disease in the differential diagnoses during mortality events in Antarctica.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Royal Society B: Biological Sciences

papers.title_zh: 禽流感导致企鹅超级繁殖地出现大规模死亡事件,同时南极洲出现H5N1高致病性禽流感病毒暴发
papers.source_body_en: Abstract The characterization of pathogens affecting Antarctic wildlife has been historically limited and sporadic. With the introduction of H5N1 high pathogenicity avian influenza virus (HPAIV) in Antarctica in the austral summer 2023/2024, concerns about the health of Antarctic seabirds and mammals prompted immediate surveillance efforts. In March 2024, we visited the Danger Islands archipelago, that hosts two mega-colonies of Adélie penguins, and observed an unusual mortality estimated in thousands of Adélie penguins and other species. Swabs and tissues were collected for molecular detection of infectious agents from 49 carcasses, and additional tissues for histology from a selection of 9 carcasses. We detected Pasteurella multocida DNA in 46 of 49 individuals, and diagnosed avian cholera as the cause of death of most of these animals. By shotgun sequencing, we retrieved the first genomic sequences of the P. multocida strain from this region, and the phylogenetic analysis showed a close relation with strains from other locations retrieved during the same expedition and with strains previously reported in the Southern Ocean area. This study confirms avian cholera as a relevant cause of mortality in the Antarctic, and overall highlights the importance of considering this disease in the differential diagnoses during mortality events in Antarctica.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 长期以来,对影响南极野生动物的病原体的特征描述受到限制且零散。随着H5N1高致病性禽流感病毒(HPAIV)在2023/2024南半球夏季首次引入南极洲,人们对南极海鸟和哺乳动物健康的担忧促使了立即的监测行动。2024年3月,我们访问了危险群岛群岛,该群岛拥有两个企鹅超级繁殖地,观察到数千只阿德利企鹅及其他物种的异常死亡。从49具尸体中采集拭子和组织样本,进行感染因子的分子检测,并从其中9具尸体中选取额外的组织样本进行组织学分析。我们检测到46/49个体中存在Pasteurella multocida DNA,并诊断为禽流感导致了这些动物的大部分死亡。通过霰弹枪测序,我们获得了该地区Pasteurella multocida菌株的首个基因组序列,系统发育分析显示其与其他地点在同一探险期间采集的菌株以及之前在南大洋地区报道的菌株有密切关系。本研究确认了禽流感是南极洲大规模死亡事件的相关原因,并总体强调了在南极洲大规模死亡事件中考虑该疾病作为鉴别诊断的重要性。
papers.summary_zh: 摘要 长期以来,对影响南极野生动物的病原体的特征描述受到限制且零散。随着H5N1高致病性禽流感病毒(HPAIV)在2023/2024南半球夏季首次引入南极洲,人们对南极海鸟和哺乳动物健康的担忧促使了立即的监测行动。2024年3月,我们访问了危险群岛群岛,该群岛拥有两个企鹅超级繁殖地,观察到数千只阿德利企鹅及其他物种的异常死亡。从49具尸体中采集拭子和组织样本,进行感染因子的分子检测,并从其中9具尸体中选取额外的组织样本进行组织学分析。我们检测到46/49个体中存在Pasteurella multocida DNA,并诊断为禽流感导致了这些动物的大部分死亡。通过霰弹枪测序,我们获得了该地区Pasteurella multocida菌株的首个基因组序列,系统发育分析显示其与其他地点在同一探险期间采集的菌株以及之前在南大洋地区报道的菌株有密切关系。本研究确认了禽流感是南极洲大规模死亡事件的相关原因,并总体强调了在南极洲大规模死亡事件中考虑该疾病作为鉴别诊断的重要性。

papers.title: The United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention response to Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A(H5N1): surveillance, diagnostics, risk assessment, and public health preparedness from 1996 to 2026
papers.abstract: Avian influenza A(H5N1) remains a major zoonotic and pandemic concern because of its extensive circulation in birds, repeated spillover into mammals, and capacity to cause illness in humans ranging from asymptomatic infection or conjunctivitis to fatal pneumonia. The detection of clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 in United States dairy cattle in 2024 created a persistent animal-human interface that required coordinated action across public health, animal health, occupational health, agriculture, and food safety. This review critically examines the role of the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in H5N1 surveillance, laboratory diagnosis, genomic risk assessment, clinical guidance, occupational protection, communication, and pandemic preparedness. A structured narrative review was conducted using PubMed and authoritative sources from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), World Health Organization (WHO), Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH), U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), and U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). The search covered January 1996 through 24 July 2026. Sources were screened for direct relevance and synthesized by predefined thematic domains. Table 1 presents a focused evidence map of key H5N1-specific studies and reports. The CDC response uses surveillance systems, monitoring of exposed persons, public-health laboratory testing, rapid H5 subtyping, sequencing, antigenic characterization, and antiviral-susceptibility assessment. Human infections associated with the United States cattle and poultry outbreaks were predominantly mild and commonly involved conjunctivitis or upper-respiratory symptoms, although severe and fatal disease occurred. Preventive measures include occupational PPE guidance, monitoring and testing of exposed persons, infection-control recommendations, risk communication, and antiviral prophylaxis following selected high-risk exposures.” Important limitations include uneven testing, incomplete participation by exposed workers, barriers to personal protective equipment use, rapidly changing surveillance data, and uncertainty regarding the frequency of mild or asymptomatic infection. The reviewed serosurveys also indicated that symptom-based surveillance can miss infections in exposed workers. The CDC-centered response has expanded detection and preparedness, but its effectiveness depends on sustained One Health coordination, timely animal-outbreak control, accessible worker-centered testing, transparent data sharing, and continuous evaluation of viral evolution, diagnostic performance, antiviral susceptibility, and candidate vaccine-virus match and the need for stronger integration of animal and human data.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) response to avian influenza A(H5N1) from 1996 to 2026, focusing on surveillance, diagnostics, risk assessment, and pandemic preparedness. The evidence highlights the CDC's use of surveillance systems, laboratory testing, and genomic analysis to monitor H5N1 outbreaks in birds and mammals. Human infections linked to these outbreaks are mostly mild, with conjunctivitis and upper-respiratory symptoms being common, though severe cases have occurred. The review identifies key limitations, including uneven testing, incomplete worker participation, and challenges in symptom-based surveillance. It emphasizes the need for sustained One Health coordination, timely outbreak control, and continuous evaluation of viral evolution and diagnostic performance. Research and practice implications include the importance of occupational PPE guidance, worker testing, and antiviral prophylaxis for high-risk exposures.

papers.abstract_zh: H5N1禽流感病毒仍是一个重要的人兽共患病和大流行病担忧,因为它在鸟类中的广泛传播、反复跨物种溢出到哺乳动物以及在人类中引起从无症状感染或结膜炎到致命性肺炎的疾病。2024年在美国奶牛中检测到H5N1病毒的2.3.4.4b亚型,创建了一个持续的动物-人类接触界面,需要公共卫生、动物健康、职业健康、农业和食品安全等多个领域的协调行动。本综述批判性地探讨了美国疾病控制与预防中心(CDC)在H5N1病毒监测、实验室诊断、基因组风险评估、临床指导、职业防护、沟通和大流行病准备中的作用。通过PubMed和权威来源(包括CDC、世界卫生组织(WHO)、联合国粮食及农业组织(FAO)、世界动物卫生组织(WOAH)、美国农业部(USDA)和美国食品药品监督管理局(FDA))进行了结构化的叙述性综述。搜索时间范围为1996年1月至2026年7月24日。来源根据直接相关性进行筛选,并按预定义的主题领域进行综合。表1呈现了与H5N1病毒相关的关键研究和报告的聚焦证据地图。CDC的应对措施包括病毒监测系统、对暴露人员的监测、公共卫生实验室检测、快速H5亚型鉴定、测序、抗原特征分析以及抗病毒药物敏感性评估。与美国奶牛和禽类相关的H5N1人类感染主要为轻度,通常涉及结膜炎或上呼吸道症状,尽管也出现了严重和致命的病例。预防措施包括职业防护的PPE指导、对暴露人员的监测和检测、感染控制建议、风险沟通以及在选定的高风险暴露后进行抗病毒药物预防。重要的局限性包括检测不均衡、暴露工作者参与不完全、个人防护装备使用障碍、病毒监测数据快速变化以及对轻度或无症状感染频率的不确定性。综述的血清学调查还表明,基于症状的病毒监测可能会漏掉暴露工作者中的感染。以CDC为中心的应对措施已扩大了检测和准备范围,但其有效性取决于持续的One Health协调、及时的动物-人类感染控制、可及的以工作者为中心的检测、透明的数据共享以及对病毒系统发育、诊断性能、抗病毒药物敏感性和候选疫苗-病毒匹配的持续评估,同时需要更强的动物和人类数据整合。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 禽流感 A(H5N1) 仍然是一个主要的人兽共患病和大流行病担忧,因为它在鸟类中广泛传播,反复 跨物种溢出 到哺乳动物,并且能够引起人类从无症状感染或结膜炎到致命性肺炎的疾病。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 采用结构化叙述性综述方法,使用PubMed和来自疾病控制与预防中心(CDC)、世界卫生组织(WHO)、联合国粮食及农业组织(FAO)、世界动物卫生组织(WOAH)、美国农业部(USDA)和美国食品药品监督管理局(FDA)的权威资料进行文献检索,时间范围为1996年1月到2026年7月24日。文献筛选基于直接相关性,并按预定义的主题领域进行综合。表1展示了与H5N1相关的重点研究和报告的证据地图。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: CDC的应对措施包括跨物种溢出监测系统、对暴露人员的监测、公共卫生实验室检测、快速H5亚型鉴定、测序、抗原表征以及跨物种溢出易感性评估。与美国奶牛和禽类跨物种溢出相关的感染病例主要为轻度,常见于结膜炎或上呼吸道症状,尽管也发生了严重和致命性疾病。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 重要局限性包括检测不均衡、暴露工作者参与不完整、个人防护装备使用障碍、快速变化的跨物种溢出数据以及对轻度或无症状感染频率的不确定性。综述的血清学调查还表明,基于症状的跨物种溢出检测可能漏诊暴露工作者的感染。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 预防措施包括职业防护的抗病毒药物指导、对暴露人员的监测和检测、感染控制建议、风险沟通以及在选定的高风险暴露后进行抗病毒药物预防。

papers.title: Seroprevalence of Avian Influenza Viruses (H5N1 and H9N2) Among Poultry Workers and Live-Bird Market Vendors in Asia: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.abstract: Poultry workers and live-bird market vendors represent a critical zoonotic interface for avian influenza transmission in Asia; yet, to our knowledge, no prior PRISMA 2020-compliant meta-analysis has concurrently pooled H5N1 and H9N2 seroprevalence in this population. We systematically reviewed 22 studies (7 countries/territories, 26,413 participants across the 21 studies reporting sample sizes; PROSPERO: CRD420261380328). Using DerSimonian–Laird random-effects models with Freeman–Tukey double-arcsine transformation, pooled seroprevalence was 2.38% (95% CI 0.62–5.23%) for H5N1 (12 cohorts from 11 unique studies) and 11.79% (95% CI 5.96–19.27%) for H9N2 (13 studies). South Asian H9N2 seroprevalence (24.9%; k = 4 studies) was approximately four-fold higher than that of East Asia (5.9%; k = 9 studies). These findings highlight substantial, regionally uneven occupational exposure risk and an urgent need for standardized surveillance in underrepresented settings like Nepal.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis assesses the seroprevalence of avian influenza A viruses H5N1 and H9N2 among poultry workers and live-bird market vendors in Asia. The review included 22 studies from seven countries/territories, involving 26,413 participants. Pooled seroprevalence estimates were calculated using DerSimonian–Laird random-effects models with Freeman–Tukey double-arcsine transformation, yielding 2.38% (95% CI 0.62–5.23%) for H5N1 and 11.79% (95% CI 5.96–19.27%) for H9N2. Notably, H9N2 seroprevalence in South Asia was significantly higher than in East Asia, suggesting regional disparities in exposure. The findings underscore the need for standardized surveillance in underrepresented areas, such as Nepal, to better understand and mitigate occupational risks associated with avian influenza.

papers.title: Surveillance of zoonotic avian influenza viruses H5N1 and H9N2 in selected live bird markets in Northern Nigeria: public health implications
papers.abstract: Avian influenza viruses (AIVs), including highly pathogenic H5N1 and low pathogenic H9N2, represent significant zoonotic threats. Both subtypes have been repeatedly introduced into Nigeria since their initial detection in West Africa in 2006 and 2017, respectively. This study aimed to investigate the current genetic diversity and spillover potential of these viruses through active surveillance in live bird markets (LBMs) in Hadejia and Kano, Nigeria, from March to November 2022. We sampled 219 birds, collecting two swabs per bird (438 swab specimens). A positive bird was defined as having at least one positive swab. At the bird level, highly pathogenic H5N1 was detected in 3/125 (2.4%) apparently healthy guinea fowl at Sabon Gari LBM in Kano. Notably, low pathogenic H9N2 was detected at a substantially higher prevalence, 10/94 (10.6%) in chickens at Hadejia LBM. Overall, 13/219 (5.9%) birds were positive for either H5N1 or H9N2. Phylogenetic and selection pressure analysis confirmed that the H9N2 viruses belong to the G1 lineage and harbor key mammalian adaptation signatures in the hemagglutinin (HA) gene, including S143T, S145T, and S121T, which are associated with increased affinity for human-like α2–6 sialic acid receptors. Phylogenetic analysis placed the H5N1 strain within clade 2.3.4.4b, showing close genetic relationships with viruses responsible for the 2021–2022 Nigerian epidemic and subsequent outbreaks in Niger in early 2023. H5N1 and H9N2 were detected in different Nigerian live bird markets. Although these findings do not provide evidence of current co-circulation or reassortment, the detection of both subtypes within the broader LBM system, together with putative mammalian adaptation markers in H9N2, highlights a potential reassortment risk should these viruses later co-circulate within the same market and co-infect the same host. Continued genomic surveillance is therefore warranted to detect future viral convergence and emergent reassortant strains and to inform pandemic preparedness and control strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 禽流感病毒(AIVs),包括高致病性H5N1和低致病性H9N2,代表了重要的跨物种传播威胁。这两种亚型自2006年和2017年首次在西非被发现以来,已多次被引入尼日利亚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究旨在通过2022年3月至11月在尼日利亚哈代亚和卡诺地区的活禽市场(LBMs)中主动采集样本,调查这些病毒当前的遗传多样性及其潜在传播能力。我们采集了219只鸟类,每只鸟类采集两个拭子样本(共438个拭子样本)。
elements_zh.methods: 阳性鸟类被定义为至少有一个拭子样本呈阳性。系统发育和选择压力分析证实,H9N2病毒属于G1谱系,并在血凝素(HA)基因中携带关键的哺乳动物适应性标志,包括S143T、S145T和S121T,这些标志与对人类样α2–6唾液酸受体的更高亲和力相关。

papers.title_zh: 北尼日利亚选定活禽市场中高致病性H5N1和低致病性H9N2人兽共患病禽流感病毒的传播:公共卫生意义
papers.source_body_en: Avian influenza viruses (AIVs), including highly pathogenic H5N1 and low pathogenic H9N2, represent significant zoonotic threats. Both subtypes have been repeatedly introduced into Nigeria since their initial detection in West Africa in 2006 and 2017, respectively. This study aimed to investigate the current genetic diversity and spillover potential of these viruses through active surveillance in live bird markets (LBMs) in Hadejia and Kano, Nigeria, from March to November 2022. We sampled 219 birds, collecting two swabs per bird (438 swab specimens). A positive bird was defined as having at least one positive swab. At the bird level, highly pathogenic H5N1 was detected in 3/125 (2.4%) apparently healthy guinea fowl at Sabon Gari LBM in Kano. Notably, low pathogenic H9N2 was detected at a substantially higher prevalence, 10/94 (10.6%) in chickens at Hadejia LBM. Overall, 13/219 (5.9%) birds were positive for either H5N1 or H9N2. Phylogenetic and selection pressure analysis confirmed that the H9N2 viruses belong to the G1 lineage and harbor key mammalian adaptation signatures in the hemagglutinin (HA) gene, including S143T, S145T, and S121T, which are associated with increased affinity for human-like α2–6 sialic acid receptors. Phylogenetic analysis placed the H5N1 strain within clade 2.3.4.4b, showing close genetic relationships with viruses responsible for the 2021–2022 Nigerian epidemic and subsequent outbreaks in Niger in early 2023. H5N1 and H9N2 were detected in different Nigerian live bird markets. Although these findings do not provide evidence of current co-circulation or reassortment, the detection of both subtypes within the broader LBM system, together with putative mammalian adaptation markers in H9N2, highlights a potential reassortment risk should these viruses later co-circulate within the same market and co-infect the same host. Continued genomic surveillance is therefore warranted to detect future viral convergence and emergent reassortant strains and to inform pandemic preparedness and control strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 禽流感病毒(AIVs),包括高致病性H5N1和低致病性H9N2,代表了重要的跨物种传播威胁。这两种亚型自2006年和2017年首次在西非被发现以来,已多次被引入尼日利亚。本研究旨在通过2022年3月至11月在尼日利亚哈代亚和卡诺地区的活禽市场(LBMs)中主动采集样本,调查这些病毒当前的遗传多样性及其潜在传播能力。我们采集了219只鸟类,每只鸟类采集两个拭子样本(共438个拭子样本)。阳性鸟类被定义为至少有一个拭子样本呈阳性。在鸟类层面,高致病性H5N1在卡诺地区的Sabon Gari活禽市场中125只看似健康的火鸡中有3只(2.4%)被检测到。值得注意的是,低致病性H9N2在哈代亚活禽市场中鸡群中的检出率显著更高,为94只鸡中有10只(10.6%)。总体而言,219只鸟类中有13只(5.9%)对H5N1或H9N2呈阳性。系统发育和选择压力分析证实,H9N2病毒属于G1谱系,并在血凝素(HA)基因中携带关键的哺乳动物适应性标志,包括S143T、S145T和S121T,这些标志与对人类样α2–6唾液酸受体的更高亲和力相关。系统发育分析将H5N1毒株归类于2.3.4.4b分支,显示出与2021–2022年尼日利亚疫情以及随后2023年初尼日尔暴发的病毒密切的遗传关系。H5N1和H9N2病毒在不同的尼日利亚活禽市场中被检测到。尽管这些发现并未提供当前共循环或基因重配的证据,但H9N2病毒在更广泛的活禽市场系统中同时检测到,以及其携带的潜在哺乳动物适应性标志,表明如果这些病毒未来在同一市场共循环并感染同一宿主,可能会存在基因重配的风险。因此,有必要继续监测以检测未来的病毒汇聚和新兴重配毒株,并为大流行病防控策略提供信息。

papers.title: A qualitative study exploring poultry farmers’ barriers and motivations to seasonal human influenza vaccine uptake as a preventive public health measure because of avian influenza
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: The global spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza (H5N1) has increased concerns about reassortment between avian and human influenza viruses and the potential emergence of novel pandemic influenza strains. Annual seasonal influenza vaccination can reduce this risk and is recommended by the Dutch government and the World Health Organization (WHO) for risk groups, including poultry farmers. This study explored Dutch poultry farmers’ perceptions regarding this vaccination and identified motivations and barriers influencing their willingness to be vaccinated. Methods: This qualitative study involved semistructured interviews with twelve poultry farmers in the Netherlands. Interviews were conducted online via Microsoft Teams between June and October 2024. The interview guide was based on the attitude‒social influence‒self-efficacy (ASE) model. Interviews were transcribed verbatim and analysed using thematic analysis. Results: Attitudes towards vaccination differed both generally and regarding seasonal influenza vaccination due to avian influenza risk. Approximately half considered vaccination a reasonable preventive measure. The main motivation for vaccination was preventing reassortment between avian and human influenza viruses and thereby reducing the risk of a future pandemic. Participants also viewed vaccination as a sign of societal responsibility and a way to contribute positively to the public image of the poultry sector. Important barriers included diminished trust in the government, perceived regulatory burden within the poultry sector, and perceived limited benefits of vaccination. Participants emphasized that vaccination should remain voluntary. Participants generally perceived their personal risk of avian influenza infection as low, while acknowledging potentially severe consequences for public health if a novel influenza virus were to emerge. Trusted sources of information included veterinarians, general practitioners, poultry advisers, and agricultural organizations. Accessibility was considered essential: local, flexible in timing, and free of charge. Conclusions: Acceptance of seasonal influenza vaccination among poultry farmers is influenced by a combination of societal responsibility, perceived risk, trust in the government, and practical considerations. Vaccination strategies should emphasize the societal benefits of vaccination and the potentially serious public health consequences of the emergence of a novel influenza virus. Improving vaccine uptake among poultry farmers requires engagement of trusted intermediaries and vaccination programs that are accessible and tailored to farmers’ practical needs.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore poultry farmers’ perceptions of seasonal human influenza vaccination as a preventive measure against avian influenza, given the global spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza (H5N1) and concerns about reassortment between avian and human influenza viruses.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This qualitative study involved semistructured interviews with twelve poultry farmers in the Netherlands, conducted online via Microsoft Teams between June and October 2024. Participants generally perceived their personal risk of avian influenza infection as low, while acknowledging potentially severe consequences for public health if a novel influenza virus were to emerge.
analysis.methods: The study used semistructured interviews based on the attitude‒social influence‒self-efficacy (ASE) model. Interviews were transcribed verbatim and analysed using thematic analysis. The interview guide was designed to explore perceptions and motivations related to vaccination.
analysis.main_results: Attitudes towards vaccination differed both generally and regarding seasonal influenza vaccination due to avian influenza risk. Approximately half considered vaccination a reasonable preventive measure. Accessibility was considered essential: local, flexible in timing, and free of charge.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight that vaccination acceptance among poultry farmers is influenced by a combination of societal responsibility, perceived risk, trust in the government, and practical considerations. The study identifies key motivations and barriers related to vaccine uptake in this specific group.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform public health strategies by emphasizing the importance of addressing societal perceptions, trust in government, and practical accessibility when promoting seasonal influenza vaccination among poultry farmers to mitigate the risk of avian influenza reassortment.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to twelve participants, which may restrict generalisability. The evidence is based on qualitative interviews, which provide rich insights but lack quantitative data. The confidence in the findings is moderate due to the small sample size and the nature of the study.

analysis.summary_en: This qualitative study investigated poultry farmers’ perceptions of seasonal human influenza vaccination as a preventive measure against avian influenza, particularly in light of the global spread of H5N1. Twelve Dutch poultry farmers were interviewed between June and October 2024, using a guide based on the ASE model. The results showed that attitudes towards vaccination varied, with about half considering it a reasonable preventive measure. Key motivations included preventing reassortment between avian and human influenza viruses and reducing pandemic risk, while barriers included low perceived personal risk, distrust in government, and regulatory burdens. The study suggests that vaccination acceptance is influenced by societal responsibility, trust, and practical considerations. The findings highlight the need for vaccination programs that are accessible and tailored to farmers’ needs, with engagement from trusted intermediaries. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the small sample size and qualitative nature of the study.

papers.title_zh: 探索养禽农民对季节性人类流感疫苗疫苗接种的看法及其作为预防禽流感措施的动机和障碍
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background: The global spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza (H5N1) has increased concerns about reassortment between avian and human influenza viruses and the potential emergence of novel pandemic influenza strains. Annual seasonal influenza vaccination can reduce this risk and is recommended by the Dutch government and the World Health Organization (WHO) for risk groups, including poultry farmers. This study explored Dutch poultry farmers’ perceptions regarding this vaccination and identified motivations and barriers influencing their willingness to be vaccinated. Methods: This qualitative study involved semistructured interviews with twelve poultry farmers in the Netherlands. Interviews were conducted online via Microsoft Teams between June and October 2024. The interview guide was based on the attitude‒social influence‒self-efficacy (ASE) model. Interviews were transcribed verbatim and analysed using thematic analysis. Results: Attitudes towards vaccination differed both generally and regarding seasonal influenza vaccination due to avian influenza risk. Approximately half considered vaccination a reasonable preventive measure. The main motivation for vaccination was preventing reassortment between avian and human influenza viruses and thereby reducing the risk of a future pandemic. Participants also viewed vaccination as a sign of societal responsibility and a way to contribute positively to the public image of the poultry sector. Important barriers included diminished trust in the government, perceived regulatory burden within the poultry sector, and perceived limited benefits of vaccination. Participants emphasized that vaccination should remain voluntary. Participants generally perceived their personal risk of avian influenza infection as low, while acknowledging potentially severe consequences for public health if a novel influenza virus were to emerge. Trusted sources of information included veterinarians, general practitioners, poultry advisers, and agricultural organizations. Accessibility was considered essential: local, flexible in timing, and free of charge. Conclusions: Acceptance of seasonal influenza vaccination among poultry farmers is influenced by a combination of societal responsibility, perceived risk, trust in the government, and practical considerations. Vaccination strategies should emphasize the societal benefits of vaccination and the potentially serious public health consequences of the emergence of a novel influenza virus. Improving vaccine uptake among poultry farmers requires engagement of trusted intermediaries and vaccination programs that are accessible and tailored to farmers’ practical needs.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景:高致病性禽流感(H5N1)在全球范围的传播增加了人们对禽流感病毒与人类流感病毒重组以及新型大流行流感病毒出现的担忧。每年季节性流感疫苗接种可以降低这种风险,并且荷兰政府和世界卫生组织(WHO)建议风险群体,包括家禽养殖户,进行疫苗接种。本研究探讨了荷兰家禽养殖户对这一疫苗接种的看法,并确定了影响他们接种意愿的动机和障碍。方法:本研究为定性研究,对荷兰十二名家禽养殖户进行了半结构化访谈。访谈于2024年6月至10月期间通过Microsoft Teams在线进行。访谈指南基于态度-社会影响-自我效能(ASE)模型。访谈内容被逐字转录,并采用主题分析法进行分析。结果:受访者对疫苗接种的态度因禽流感风险而有所不同。大约有一半的人认为疫苗接种是一种合理的预防措施。接种疫苗接种的主要动机是防止禽流感病毒与人类流感病毒的重组,从而降低未来大流行的风险。受访者还视疫苗接种为一种社会责任的体现,并认为这是积极改善家禽行业公众形象的方式。重要的障碍包括对政府信任度的下降、家禽行业内部感知到的监管负担以及对疫苗接种益处的感知有限。受访者强调疫苗接种应保持自愿性质。受访者普遍认为自己感染禽流感的风险较低,但承认如果出现新型流感病毒,可能会对公众健康造成严重后果。他们信任的信息来源包括兽医、全科医生、家禽顾问以及农业组织。可及性被视为关键因素:本地化、时间灵活以及免费。结论:家禽养殖户对季节性流感疫苗接种的接受度受到社会责任感、感知风险、对政府的信任以及实际考虑因素的综合影响。疫苗接种策略应强调其社会益处以及新型流感病毒出现可能带来的严重公共卫生后果。提高家禽养殖户对疫苗的接种率需要依靠受信任的中间人以及符合养殖户实际需求的疫苗接种计划。

papers.title: Avian influenza A virus polymerase gene leads to temperature-resistant genome replication
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Influenza A viruses (IAV) pose a persistent pandemic threat. Successful cross-species transmission from waterfowl to mammals requires host adaptation for efficient replication and spread. Avian IAVs are adapted to the temperature of the avian gut, approximately 41°C, while human IAVs replicate at 33°C in the upper respiratory tract. PB1, the catalytic core of the viral heterotrimeric RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp), is essential for viral RNA synthesis. Three pandemic IAV strains (1918, 1957, and 1968) carried an avian-origin PB1 gene, suggesting a selective advantage. Fever, a critical antiviral response, elevates body temperature to 38°C or higher and can restrict viral replication. We hypothesized that avian PB1 may allow IAV replication at febrile temperatures. Using a mini-replicon system, we demonstrate that a polymerase of a seasonal human H1N1 IAV fails to replicate viral RNA efficiently at 40°C, whereas substitution of the PB1 with that from the 1918, 1957, and 1968 pandemic viruses, or a low-pathogenic avian H2N1 virus, restores RNA synthesis. Chimeric seasonal human H1N1 viruses expressing avian or 1918 PB1 replicate at 40°C in MDCK cells, unlike wild-type H1N1. Activity assays with purified chimeric IAV polymerases further suggest that avian-origin PB1 may intrinsically enhance polymerase activity at elevated temperatures. Together, these data show that avian-origin PB1 enables IAV replication at febrile temperatures, highlighting its role in zoonotic emergence and host adaptation. Surveillance of avian-origin PB1 genes in IAVs circulating in mammals may help identify strains with pandemic potential and inform the development of countermeasures. IMPORTANCE Influenza A viruses of avian origin remain a persistent threat to human health. The 1918, 1957, and 1968 pandemic influenza viruses each acquired an avian-origin PB1 gene, but the adaptive advantage conferred by these genes remains incompletely understood. Here, we show that avian-origin PB1 genes enhance viral RNA replication by a seasonal human influenza virus polymerase at elevated temperature and enable replication of a human influenza virus at 40°C, a temperature relevant to both avian hosts and human febrile illness. PB1-dependent effects were observed in cell-based polymerase assays, with purified polymerase, and during authentic virus infection. These findings identify temperature-resistant genome replication as a potential adaptive property of avian-origin PB1 and suggest that acquisition of an avian PB1 may help influenza viruses overcome temperature barriers encountered during adaptation to mammalian hosts.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 流感A病毒(IAV)对人类健康构成持续的流行威胁。从水禽到哺乳动物的成功跨物种传播需要IAV进行适应性改变以实现高效的复制和传播。禽类IAV适应于禽类肠道的温度,约为41°C,而人类IAV则在上呼吸道的33°C温度下复制。PB1是病毒异三聚体RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶(RdRp)的催化核心,对于病毒RNA合成至关重要。三种大流行IAV株(1918年、1957年和1968年)携带了源自禽类的PB1基因,这表明其具有选择优势。发热是一种关键的免疫反应,会将体温升高至38°C或更高,并可能限制病毒复制。我们假设禽类PB1可能允许IAV在发热温度下复制。利用一种微型复制子系统,我们证明了季节性人类H1N1 IAV的聚合酶在40°C下无法高效复制病毒RNA,而将PB1替换为源自1918年、1957年和1968年大流行病毒或低致病性禽类H2N1病毒的PB1基因后,RNA合成得以恢复。在MDCK细胞中,表达禽类或1918年PB1的季节性人类H1N1病毒株可以在40°C下复制,而野生型H1N1病毒则不能。使用纯化的嵌合IAV聚合酶进行活性测定进一步表明,源自禽类的PB1可能在高温下内在性地增强聚合酶活性。这些数据表明,源自禽类的PB1基因使IAV能够在发热温度下复制,突显了其在人兽共患病出现和适应性改变中的作用。在哺乳动物中流行的IAV中,源自禽类的PB1基因的特征可能有助于识别具有大流行潜力的病毒株,并为开发应对措施提供信息。重要性 源自禽类的流感A病毒仍然是人类健康的一个持续威胁。1918年、1957年和1968年的大流行流感病毒都获得了源自禽类的PB1基因,但这些基因所带来的适应性优势仍不完全清楚。在这里,我们展示了源自禽类的PB1基因如何增强季节性人类流感病毒聚合酶在高温下的病毒RNA复制能力,并使人类流感病毒能够在40°C下复制,这一温度与禽类和人类发热疾病均相关。在基于细胞的聚合酶实验中,以及在纯化的聚合酶和真实病毒感染过程中均观察到了PB1依赖性效应。这些发现将温度耐受性复制识别为源自禽类PB1的潜在适应性特征,并表明获得禽类PB1可能有助于流感病毒在适应哺乳动物宿主时克服温度障碍。

papers.full_text: Abstract Purpose of Review Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) has moved from recurrent poultry epizootics to a geographically extensive, multi-host panzootic involving wild birds, domestic animals, marine and terrestrial mammals, and exposed people. This expert review examines the epidemiologic transitions that produced the present wildlife-livestock-human interface and identifies surveillance priorities supported by original epidemiologic, genomic, experimental, and environmental studies. Recent Findings Recent primary studies show that clade 2.3.4.4b viruses are repeatedly introduced and redistributed by wild birds, can reach remote ecosystems, and have generated consequential mammalian outbreaks. The dairy-cattle emergence was especially important because genomic and pathology data demonstrated mammary-gland tropism, efficient cattle-to-cattle spread, interstate dissemination through animal movement, and secondary exposure of farm workers. Environmental sampling of water and sediment can complement bird sampling, while paired serology can complement investigation of confirmed occupational infections. Summary Surveillance should shift from separate poultry, wildlife, livestock, and human programs toward risk-based One Health networks that link field observations, laboratory testing, genomic data, animal movements, environmental matrices, and occupational health. Priority outcomes are earlier detection, faster cross-sector investigation, and rapid recognition of viral changes associated with altered host range or transmission. Similar content being viewed by others Data Availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. Code Availability Not applicable. No software code, computational model, or analytical algorithm was developed for this review. Materials Availability Not applicable. This review did not generate or use new biological materials, experimental resources, or proprietary datasets. papers.title_original: Wildlife-Livestock-Human Interfaces in the Global H5N1 Panzootic: Epidemiologic Shifts and Surveillance Priorities

analysis.scope_and_question: Avian influenza A viruses, avian-origin zoonotic infections, and qualified avian subtypes. The review focuses on the epidemiologic shifts of H5N1 and other avian influenza viruses from poultry epizootics to a panzootic involving wild birds, domestic animals, and humans. The central question is how these viruses have transitioned across species and environments, and what surveillance strategies are needed.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is an expert analysis of original epidemiologic, genomic, experimental, and environmental studies. It does not report on study counts, databases, or meta-analysis. The methods section includes a case-control study of risk factors for avian influenza A (H5N1) disease in Hong Kong, 1997, and references to primary studies on clade 2.3.4.4b viruses. The review does not describe a formal meta-analysis or consensus process.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that H5N1 viruses have transitioned from poultry epizootics to a panzootic involving multiple hosts, including wild birds, domestic animals, and humans. It highlights the importance of clade 2.3.4.4b viruses in this transition, noting their ability to reach remote ecosystems and cause consequential mammalian outbreaks. The dairy-cattle emergence is emphasized due to its implications for transmission and zoonotic potential.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies gaps in understanding the mechanisms of cross-species transmission and the environmental factors that facilitate viral spread. It notes that while genomic and pathology data support the role of H5N1 in mammalian outbreaks, there is limited evidence on the full extent of its host range and the specific pathways of transmission to humans. The review also highlights the need for more comprehensive surveillance across wildlife-livestock-human interfaces.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review recommends shifting surveillance efforts toward risk-based One Health networks that integrate field observations, laboratory testing, genomic data, animal movements, and occupational health. It emphasizes the importance of early detection, faster cross-sector investigation, and rapid recognition of viral changes associated with altered host range or transmission. Environmental sampling and paired serology are suggested as complementary tools for monitoring H5N1 activity.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the epidemiologic shifts of avian influenza A(H5N1) viruses from poultry epizootics to a panzootic involving wild birds, domestic animals, and humans. It highlights the role of clade 2.3.4.4b viruses in spreading to remote ecosystems and causing mammalian outbreaks, particularly in dairy cattle. The review underscores the need for integrated surveillance strategies that combine field observations, genomic data, and environmental sampling. It identifies gaps in understanding transmission mechanisms and calls for improved cross-sector collaboration to detect and respond to viral changes. The implications emphasize the importance of risk-based One Health networks for monitoring and mitigating the spread of H5N1.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 禽流感 A 病毒、禽源性人兽共患病和合格的禽亚型。本回顾重点研究了H5N1和其他禽流感病毒从家禽流行病转变为涉及野生动物、家养动物和人类的泛流行病的流行病学转变。中心问题是这些病毒如何跨越物种和环境进行传播,以及需要哪些监测策略。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本回顾是对原始流行病学、基因组、实验和环境研究的专家分析。它没有报告研究数量、数据库或元分析。方法部分包括了1997年香港禽流感 A (H5N1) 疾病风险因素的队列研究,以及关于clade 2.3.4.4b 病毒的初步研究参考。本回顾没有描述正式的元分析或共识过程。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 本回顾得出结论,H5N1 病毒已从家禽流行病转变为涉及多种宿主的泛流行病,包括野生动物、家养动物和人类。它强调了clade 2.3.4.4b 病毒在这一转变中的重要性,指出它们能够到达偏远生态系统并引起重要的哺乳动物暴发。特别强调了奶牛的出现,因为它对传播和人兽共患病的潜在影响。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 本回顾指出了对跨物种传播机制和促进病毒传播的环境因素的理解不足。它指出,虽然基因组和病理数据支持H5N1在哺乳动物暴发中的作用,但对其全面的宿主范围和向人类传播的具体途径的证据有限。本回顾还强调了需要更全面的监测以监测野生动物-家畜-人类界面。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 本回顾建议将监测努力转向基于风险的一体化健康网络,该网络整合了现场观察、实验室测试、基因组数据、动物移动和职业健康。它强调了早期检测、跨部门调查的快速性以及对与宿主范围或传播相关的病毒变化的快速识别的重要性。环境采样和配对的血清学被建议作为监测H5N1活动的补充工具。

analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 本回顾指出了对跨物种传播机制和促进病毒传播的环境因素的理解不足。它指出,虽然基因组和病理数据支持H5N1在哺乳动物暴发中的作用,但对其全面的宿主范围和向人类传播的具体途径的证据有限。本回顾还强调了需要更全面的监测以监测野生动物-家畜-人类界面。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 本回顾建议将监测努力转向基于风险的一体化健康网络,该网络整合了现场观察、实验室测试、基因组数据、动物移动和职业健康。它强调了早期检测、跨部门调查的快速性以及对与宿主范围或传播相关的病毒变化的快速识别的重要性。环境采样和配对的血清学被建议作为监测H5N1活动的补充工具。

papers.title: Biosecurity risk factors associated with outbreaks of high pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) on poultry farms in Lower Saxony (Germany) – A case-control-study
papers.abstract: Biosecurity is an essential component when considering risk factors for high pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) and may be an explanation for the phenomenon that not all poultry farms are equally affected by outbreaks - despite similar conditions in terms of location, surroundings and size as well as type of poultry and production. In a case-control study, the association of biosecurity measures with the risk of outbreaks of HPAI in poultry farms in Lower Saxony, Germany, was investigated. In total 15 case farms with at least two previous outbreaks of HPAI and 26 control farms without such were examined during farm visits using a specially developed biosecurity checklist. In the univariable logistic regression analysis, the following factors showed a significant association with the outbreak status in poultry farms: longer distance to nearest federal highways, not short-cut grass areas around the stables, no dedicated facilities for removing carcasses from the stables, using trays instead of mats for shoe disinfection as well as feed, litter and manure storage in such a way that suppliers have to enter the clean area. In the multivariable analysis with backward stepwise regression only the variables not short-cut grass areas and no dedicated facilities for removing carcasses from the stables were identified as factors having a significant association with the HPAI outbreak status of a poultry farm. Taking these factors into account could contribute to reducing the risk of HPAI on poultry farms.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the emergence of low pathogenic avian influenza A(H7N7) virus in humans and its potential for adaptation to mammalian hosts.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on a poultry worker in Taiwan, 2026, who was infected with avian influenza A(H7N7) virus, and compared the virus to those circulating in Asian wild birds.
analysis.methods: The researchers characterized the virus through genetic analysis, identifying specific markers such as PB2 E627K associated with mammalian adaptation.
analysis.main_results: The virus isolated from the poultry worker was found to possess PB2 E627K, a marker indicating potential adaptation to mammalian hosts, and was related to viruses circulating in Asian wild birds.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the avian influenza A(H7N7) virus detected in humans may have adapted to mammalian hosts, highlighting the need for further investigation into its zoonotic potential.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results emphasize the importance of monitoring avian influenza viruses in both poultry and wild bird populations to better understand their potential to infect humans and cause outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on a single human case, but the genetic analysis provides moderate confidence in the identification of the virus's adaptation markers.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports a case of human infection with low pathogenic avian influenza A(H7N7) virus in Taiwan, 2026. The virus was found to be related to those circulating in Asian wild birds and possessed PB2 E627K, a marker associated with mammalian adaptation. The findings highlight the need for enhanced surveillance of avian influenza viruses in poultry and rapid characterization of human cases to assess pandemic potential. The study's focus on a single case limits the generalizability of the results, but the genetic analysis provides moderate confidence in the identification of adaptation markers. These results have implications for understanding the zoonotic potential of avian influenza viruses and the importance of monitoring their spread in both animal and human populations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨低致病性禽流感 A(H7N7)病毒在人类中的出现及其向哺乳动物宿主适应的潜力。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究聚焦于2026年台湾一名感染禽流感 A(H7N7)病毒的禽类工作者,并将其病毒与亚洲野生鸟类中流行的病毒进行比较。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员通过基因分析对病毒进行了特征分析,识别出与哺乳动物适应性相关的特定标记,如PB2 E627K。
elements_zh.main_results: 从禽类工作者身上分离出的病毒被发现具有PB2 E627K这一标记,表明其可能适应哺乳动物宿主,并且与亚洲野生鸟类中流行的病毒相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,检测到的人类禽流感 A(H7N7)病毒可能已适应哺乳动物宿主,突显了进一步研究其人兽共患病潜力的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果强调了对禽类和野生鸟类种群中禽流感病毒进行监测的重要性,以更好地理解其感染人类并导致暴发的潜力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于仅关注单一的人类病例,但基因分析为病毒适应性标记的识别提供了中等程度的置信度。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,检测到的人类禽流感 A(H7N7)病毒可能已适应哺乳动物宿主,突显了进一步研究其人兽共患病潜力的必要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果强调了对禽类和野生鸟类种群中禽流感病毒进行监测的重要性,以更好地理解其感染人类并导致暴发的潜力。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于仅关注单一的人类病例,但基因分析为病毒适应性标记的识别提供了中等程度的置信度。

papers.title: Antiviral Susceptibility of Clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 and H5N5 Influenza Viruses Detected in Birds in Russia During 2021–2022
papers.abstract: In this study, we aimed to analyze the antiviral susceptibility of clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 and H5N5 influenza viruses detected in Russia during 2021–2022. During this period, we investigated 40 avian influenza outbreaks in wild and domestic birds, isolating 109 H5N1 and 9 H5N5 strains. Using a genetic approach, we analyzed the presence of markers associated with reduced susceptibility to baloxavir and M2 blockers, as well as markers of reduced inhibition by neuraminidase inhibitors (NAIs). Additionally, the isolated strains were tested in a functional assay to evaluate the inhibitory activity of oseltamivir, zanamivir, and peramivir against viral neuraminidase. None of the isolates harbored genetic markers of reduced susceptibility to M2 blockers and baloxavir or reduced inhibition by NAIs. Functional assay showed that the median IC50 values of oseltamivir, zanamivir, and peramivir were 1.73, 0.49, and 0.16 nM for the H5N1 subtype, and 0.65, 1.13, and 0.12 nM for the H5N5 subtype, respectively. None of the tested strains demonstrated a ≥10-fold increase in NAI IC50 values compared to the corresponding subtype medians, and were thus classified as having a normal level of inhibition. The median IC50 values of the NAIs determined for the tested avian viruses were comparable to those of a susceptible seasonal A(H1N1)pdm09 strain, except for a slight reduction in oseltamivir activity against H5N1 viruses (4.3-fold) and zanamivir activity against H5N5 viruses (3.4-fold). Our study revealed a group of H5N1 viruses whose NA belonged to the ea5.1 genetic subclade, characterized by NA-Y253H and T452I amino acid substitutions, which exhibited a 28.8-fold decrease in oseltamivir IC50 values compared to the subtype median. These strains were detected in the European and Ural regions of Russia between May 2022 and January 2023, with no subsequent detections in the available surveillance data. To the best of our knowledge, such strains have not been identified outside Russia.

During this period, we investigated 40 avian influenza outbreaks in wild and domestic birds, isolating 109 H5N1 and 9 H5N5 strains. Using a genetic approach, we analyzed the presence of markers associated with reduced susceptibility to baloxavir and M2 blockers, as well as markers of reduced inhibition by neuraminidase inhibitors (NAIs). Additionally, the isolated strains were tested in a functional assay to evaluate the inhibitory activity of oseltamivir, zanamivir, and peramivir against viral neuraminidase. None of the isolates harbored genetic markers of reduced susceptibility to M2 blockers and baloxavir or reduced inhibition by NAIs. Functional assay showed that the median IC50 values of oseltamivir, zanamivir, and peramivir were 1.73, 0.49, and 0.16 nM for the H5N1 subtype, and 0.65, 1.13, and 0.12 nM for the H5N5 subtype, respectively. None of the tested strains demonstrated a ≥10-fold increase in NAI IC50 values compared to the corresponding subtype medians, and were thus classified as having a normal level of inhibition. The median IC50 values of the NAIs determined for the tested avian viruses were comparable to those of a susceptible seasonal A(H1N1)pdm09 strain, except for a slight reduction in oseltamivir activity against H5N1 viruses (4.3-fold) and zanamivir activity against H5N5 viruses (3.4-fold). Our study revealed a group of H5N1 viruses whose NA belonged to the ea5.1 genetic subclade, characterized by NA-Y253H and T452I amino acid substitutions, which exhibited a 28.8-fold decrease in oseltamivir IC50 values compared to the subtype median. These strains were detected in the European and Ural regions of Russia between May 2022 and January 2023, with no subsequent detections in the available surveillance data. To the best of our knowledge, such strains have not been identified outside Russia.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to analyze the antiviral susceptibility of clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 and H5N5 influenza viruses detected in Russia during 2021–2022. The research addresses the need to understand antiviral resistance in avian influenza viruses, which is critical for effective treatment and control strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study investigated 40 avian influenza outbreaks in wild and domestic birds, isolating 109 H5N1 and 9 H5N5 strains during 2021–2022. These strains were collected from the European and Ural regions of Russia.
analysis.methods: A genetic approach was used to analyze markers associated with reduced susceptibility to baloxavir and M2 blockers, as well as markers of reduced inhibition by neuraminidase inhibitors (NAIs). Additionally, the isolated strains were tested in a functional assay to evaluate the inhibitory activity of oseltamivir, zanamivir, and peramivir against viral neuraminidase.
analysis.main_results: None of the tested strains demonstrated a ≥10-fold increase in NAI IC50 values compared to the corresponding subtype medians, and were thus classified as having a normal level of inhibition. A group of H5N1 viruses with NA-Y253H and T452I amino acid substitutions showed a 28.8-fold decrease in oseltamivir IC50 values compared to the subtype median.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings indicate that the majority of H5N1 and H5N5 viruses isolated in Russia during 2021–2022 maintain normal susceptibility to NAIs, with a notable exception in a subgroup of H5N1 viruses showing enhanced sensitivity to oseltamivir. This highlights a potential genetic variation in antiviral response within the H5N1 subtype.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide critical information for the surveillance and management of avian influenza viruses in Russia, particularly for the H5N1 subtype. They inform the potential use of oseltamivir and other NAIs in controlling outbreaks and emphasize the importance of monitoring genetic changes in viral populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on a specific geographic region and time period, and the absence of long-term surveillance data may affect the generalizability of findings. The evidence is strong, as it is based on both genetic and functional assays of directly isolated viral strains.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the antiviral susceptibility of clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 and H5N5 influenza viruses isolated from avian outbreaks in Russia during 2021–2022. It analyzed genetic markers and performed functional assays to assess resistance to baloxavir, M2 blockers, and neuraminidase inhibitors (NAIs). The results showed that none of the isolates had markers of reduced susceptibility to these antivirals, except for a subgroup of H5N1 viruses with specific amino acid substitutions that exhibited increased sensitivity to oseltamivir. These findings are significant for understanding the potential use of NAIs in managing avian influenza outbreaks in Russia, while highlighting the need for continued surveillance to monitor genetic changes in viral populations. The study's evidence is strong, but its geographic and temporal scope may limit broader applicability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在分析2021–2022年在俄罗斯检测到的2.3.4.4b分支H5N1和H5N5流感病毒对抗病毒药物的敏感性。该研究回应了了解禽流感病毒中抗病毒药物耐药性的需求,这对于有效的治疗和控制策略至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究调查了40例禽流感 暴发在野生和家养鸟类中的情况,在2021年至2022年间分离出109株H5N1和9株H5N5毒株。这些毒株是从俄罗斯欧洲和乌拉尔地区收集的。
elements_zh.methods: 采用遗传方法分析与对巴洛沙韦和M2阻断剂降低易感性相关的标记,以及与对神经氨酸酶抑制剂(NAIs)降低抑制作用相关的标记。此外,分离的毒株还通过功能实验评估奥司他韦、扎那米韦和帕拉米韦对病毒神经氨酸酶的抑制活性。
elements_zh.main_results: 所测试的毒株均未表现出与相应亚型中位数相比≥10倍的NAI IC50值增加,因此被归类为具有正常水平的抑制作用。一组具有NA-Y253H和T452I氨基酸替换的H5N1病毒显示出与亚型中位数相比oseltamivir IC50值降低了28.8倍。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,在2021–2022年期间从俄罗斯分离出的大多数H5N1和H5N5病毒对NAIs仍保持正常敏感性,但有一小部分H5N1病毒对奥司他韦表现出增强的敏感性。这突显了H5N1亚型病毒在抗病毒药物应答中可能存在潜在的遗传变异。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为俄罗斯禽流感和监测病毒的防控提供了关键信息,特别是对于H5N1亚型。它们表明了在控制暴发病毒中使用奥司他韦和其他NAIs的潜在可能性,并强调了监测病毒种群中遗传变化的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到其关注特定地理区域和时间段的限制,且缺乏长期 监测 数据可能会影响研究结果的普遍适用性。证据是强有力的,因为它是基于直接分离的病毒株的遗传和功能检测。

papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在分析2021-2022年在俄罗斯检测到的2.3.4.4b亚群H5N1和H5N5流感病毒的抗病毒药物耐药性。在此期间,我们在野生和家养鸟类中共调查了40只禽流感 暴发,分离出109株H5N1和9株H5N5毒株。通过遗传学方法,我们分析了与减少baloxavir和M2阻断剂敏感性相关的标记物,以及减少神经氨酸酶抑制剂(NAIs)抑制作用的标记物。此外,分离出的毒株在功能试验中被测试,以评估奥司他韦、扎那米韦和帕拉米韦对病毒神经氨酸酶的抑制活性。所有分离株均未携带减少M2阻断剂和baloxavir敏感性或减少NAIs抑制作用的遗传标记。功能试验显示,奥司他韦、扎那米韦和帕拉米韦对H5N1亚型的中位IC50值分别为1.73、0.49和0.16 nM,对H5N5亚型的中位IC50值分别为0.65、1.13和0.12 nM。所有测试株均未表现出与相应亚型中位数相比≥10倍的NAI IC50值增加,因此被归类为具有正常抑制水平。所测试的禽流感病毒NAIs的中位IC50值与可感染季节性A(H1N1)pdm09株的中位值相当,除了奥司他韦对H5N1病毒的活性降低4.3倍和扎那米韦对H5N5病毒的活性降低3.4倍。我们的研究揭示了一组H5N1病毒,其NA属于ea5.1遗传亚分支,特征为NA-Y253H和T452I氨基酸替代,其奥司他韦IC50值比亚型中位值低28.8倍。这些株系在2022年5月至2023年1月期间在俄罗斯的欧洲和乌拉尔地区被检测到,此后在可用的监测数据中未再检测到。据我们所知,此类株系未在俄罗斯以外地区被识别。

papers.title: Mice immunized with N1 neuraminidase in a single cycle infectious virus or in a recombinant nanoparticle vaccine are protected against lethal challenge with highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 influenza
papers.abstract: The recent spillover of highly pathogenic (HP) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b into dairy cattle and other mammalian species has been concerning. Vaccine candidates that can be rapidly synthesized and implemented are key countermeasures for protecting the human population against emerging pathogens. Here we examine the use of a pH1N1 virus lacking the genetic material for hemagglutinin (HA), limiting the infection to a single cycle (sciIAV) or Cobalt lipid-porphyrin nanoparticles decorated with neuraminidase (NA) of HPAI H5N1 (N1-CoPoP) as vaccine candidates. C57BL/6 mice that were inoculated intranasally with a single dose of pH1N1 sciIAV did not differ in serum NA antibody compared to uninoculated mice. However, mice that were inoculated intramuscularly with the N1-CoPoP alone or in combination with pH1N1 sciIAV had increased N1 IgG antibodies. Upon lethal challenge with HPAIV H5N1, all mice inoculated with either pH1N1 sciIAV or N1-CoPoP were protected from weight loss, unlike unvaccinated mice with substantial body weight losses that succumb to viral infection between 7 and 10 days post infection (dpi). Both pH1N1 sciIAV and N1-CoPoP immunization minimized viral infection such that only one mouse receiving pH1N1 sciIAV had detectable viral titer in the lungs at 4 dpi. By 6 dpi, no mouse inoculated with pH1N1 sciIAV and/or N1-CoPoP had detectable virus in nasal turbinates, lungs or the brain, unlike the high viral titers found in uninoculated mice. Both pH1N1 sciIAV and N1-CoPoP were protective and should be investigated further as alternative vaccine candidates.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The recent spillover of highly pathogenic (HP) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b into dairy cattle and other mammalian species has been concerning. analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the protective efficacy of two vaccine candidates against highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1. The research is motivated by the recent spillover of H5N1 into mammals and the need for rapid vaccine development. The study uses a pH1N1 virus lacking hemagglutinin (sciIAV) and Cobalt lipid-porphyrin nanoparticles decorated with neuraminidase (N1-CoPoP) to immunize mice. Results show that mice inoculated with N1-CoPoP alone or in combination with sciIAV had increased N1 IgG antibodies. Upon lethal challenge with HPAIV H5N1, all vaccinated mice were protected from weight loss, while unvaccinated mice experienced substantial weight loss and succumbed to infection. The findings suggest that both vaccine candidates are protective and warrant further investigation as alternatives for human use. The study does not report limitations or evidence strength, which may affect the confidence in its conclusions.

papers.title_zh: 接种单周期感染性病毒或重组纳米颗粒N1神经氨酸酶的实验小鼠对疫苗 H5N1流感病毒的致死性挑战具有保护作用
papers.source_body_en: The recent spillover of highly pathogenic (HP) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b into dairy cattle and other mammalian species has been concerning. Vaccine candidates that can be rapidly synthesized and implemented are key countermeasures for protecting the human population against emerging pathogens. Here we examine the use of a pH1N1 virus lacking the genetic material for hemagglutinin (HA), limiting the infection to a single cycle (sciIAV) or Cobalt lipid-porphyrin nanoparticles decorated with neuraminidase (NA) of HPAI H5N1 (N1-CoPoP) as vaccine candidates. C57BL/6 mice that were inoculated intranasally with a single dose of pH1N1 sciIAV did not differ in serum NA antibody compared to uninoculated mice. However, mice that were inoculated intramuscularly with the N1-CoPoP alone or in combination with pH1N1 sciIAV had increased N1 IgG antibodies. Upon lethal challenge with HPAIV H5N1, all mice inoculated with either pH1N1 sciIAV or N1-CoPoP were protected from weight loss, unlike unvaccinated mice with substantial body weight losses that succumb to viral infection between 7 and 10 days post infection (dpi). Both pH1N1 sciIAV and N1-CoPoP immunization minimized viral infection such that only one mouse receiving pH1N1 sciIAV had detectable viral titer in the lungs at 4 dpi. By 6 dpi, no mouse inoculated with pH1N1 sciIAV and/or N1-CoPoP had detectable virus in nasal turbinates, lungs or the brain, unlike the high viral titers found in uninoculated mice. Both pH1N1 sciIAV and N1-CoPoP were protective and should be investigated further as alternative vaccine candidates.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近跨物种溢出高度致病(HP)H5N1 2.3.4.4b 系列向奶牛及其他哺乳动物物种的跨种传播令人担忧。能够快速合成并实施的疫苗候选方案是保护人群免受新发病原体侵害的关键对策。在本研究中,我们评估了缺失血凝素(HA)基因的pH1N1病毒(限制感染为单循环,称为sciIAV)以及装饰有高致病性禽流感H5N1神经氨酸酶(NA)的钴脂质-卟啉纳米颗粒(N1‐CoPoP)作为疫苗候选方案。经鼻腔单剂量接种pH1N1 sciIAV的C57BL/6 小鼠血清NA抗体水平与未接种小鼠无显著差异。然而,单独肌肉内注射N1‐CoPoP或与pH1N1 sciIAV联合接种的小鼠N1 IgG抗体水平升高。对高致病性禽流感病毒H5N1进行致死性挑战时,所有接受pH1N1 sciIAV或N1‐CoPoP接种的小鼠均未出现体重下降,而未接种疫苗的小鼠在感染后7至10天(dpi)出现显著体重下降并死亡。pH1N1 sciIAV和N1‐CoPoP免疫均显著降低病毒感染,仅有一只接受pH1N1 sciIAV的小鼠在第4天(4 dpi)的肺部检测到病毒滴度。至第6天(6 dpi),接受pH1N1 sciIAV和/或N1‐CoPoP接种的小鼠在鼻甲、肺和脑中均未检测到病毒,区别于未接种小鼠中出现的高病毒滴度。pH1N1 sciIAV和N1‐CoPoP均具保护作用,值得进一步作为替代疫苗候选方案进行研究。

papers.title: 2018–2025 Serological study on avian influenza among occupationally exposed populations in the Poyang Lake area — the region with the highest environmental surveillance positive rate in China
papers.abstract: An avian influenza virus positivity rate as high as 82.3% has been reported in Jiangxi Province, China, underscoring this region as a potential hotspot for avian influenza virus circulation. As a crucial hub for migratory birds and a region where wild birds, domestic poultry, and humans frequently overlap, Poyang Lake provides favorable ecological conditions for cross-species transmission of avian influenza viruses. This study aimed to describe the seroprevalence of antibodies against selected avian influenza virus subtypes among occupationally exposed populations at surveillance sites around Poyang Lake from 2018 to 2025, and to provide data to inform ongoing surveillance and risk assessment. A cross-sectional serological surveillance was conducted annually during winter and spring from 2018 to 2025 in Nanchang County (Nanchang) and Duchang and Wuning Counties (Jiujiang), Jiangxi Province. Serum samples were collected from occupationally exposed individuals, including backyard poultry keepers and their household members and live poultry market workers with direct poultry contact. Hemagglutination inhibition assays were performed by the National Influenza Center to assess antibody reactivity against the test antigens representing H5N6, H9N2, H7N9, H3N8, H10N3, H5N8, and H5N1. Predefined HI positivity thresholds were ≥ 1:20 for H3N8, H5N8, H5N1, H7N9, and H10N3 and ≥ 1:40 for H5N6 and H9N2. A total of 2,437 valid serum samples were analyzed (1,599 from Jiujiang and 838 from Nanchang). Overall, 108 samples (4.43%) met the predefined HI positivity threshold for H5N6, and 107 (4.39%) met the threshold for H9N2. During 2018–2020, 25 of 914 samples (2.74%) met the threshold for H7N9. During 2021–2025, 22 of 1,523 samples (1.44%) met the threshold for H3N8, including 9 of 100 samples (9.00%) collected in Nanchang in the 2024 surveillance year. Four of 1,523 samples (0.26%) met the threshold for H10N3; all four were from Jiujiang in the 2024 surveillance year. Four of 314 samples (1.27%) met the threshold for H5N8 in 2020. None of the 600 samples tested for H5N1 in the 2024 and 2025 surveillance years met the predefined threshold. HI antibody reactivity varied across subtypes, surveillance locations, and years among occupationally exposed participants around Poyang Lake. The H3N8 finding in Nanchang and the H10N3 finding in Jiujiang in the 2024 surveillance year warrant further investigation. H5N6 peaks in Jiujiang in 2021 and in Nanchang in 2022; H9N2 peaks in 2021 in Jiujiang and 2023 in Nanchang. HI reactivity alone does not establish subtype-specific human infection or local virus circulation. Continued serological surveillance, interpreted alongside poultry and environmental virological data, may inform risk assessment.

papers.title_zh: 2018–2025 在鄱阳湖地区职业暴露人群中对禽流感病毒的血清学研究——中国环境监测病毒阳性率最高的地区
papers.source_body_en: An avian influenza virus positivity rate as high as 82.3% has been reported in Jiangxi Province, China, underscoring this region as a potential hotspot for avian influenza virus circulation. As a crucial hub for migratory birds and a region where wild birds, domestic poultry, and humans frequently overlap, Poyang Lake provides favorable ecological conditions for cross-species transmission of avian influenza viruses. This study aimed to describe the seroprevalence of antibodies against selected avian influenza virus subtypes among occupationally exposed populations at surveillance sites around Poyang Lake from 2018 to 2025, and to provide data to inform ongoing surveillance and risk assessment. A cross-sectional serological surveillance was conducted annually during winter and spring from 2018 to 2025 in Nanchang County (Nanchang) and Duchang and Wuning Counties (Jiujiang), Jiangxi Province. Serum samples were collected from occupationally exposed individuals, including backyard poultry keepers and their household members and live poultry market workers with direct poultry contact. Hemagglutination inhibition assays were performed by the National Influenza Center to assess antibody reactivity against the test antigens representing H5N6, H9N2, H7N9, H3N8, H10N3, H5N8, and H5N1. Predefined HI positivity thresholds were ≥ 1:20 for H3N8, H5N8, H5N1, H7N9, and H10N3 and ≥ 1:40 for H5N6 and H9N2. A total of 2,437 valid serum samples were analyzed (1,599 from Jiujiang and 838 from Nanchang). Overall, 108 samples (4.43%) met the predefined HI positivity threshold for H5N6, and 107 (4.39%) met the threshold for H9N2. During 2018–2020, 25 of 914 samples (2.74%) met the threshold for H7N9. During 2021–2025, 22 of 1,523 samples (1.44%) met the threshold for H3N8, including 9 of 100 samples (9.00%) collected in Nanchang in the 2024 surveillance year. Four of 1,523 samples (0.26%) met the threshold for H10N3; all four were from Jiujiang in the 2024 surveillance year. Four of 314 samples (1.27%) met the threshold for H5N8 in 2020. None of the 600 samples tested for H5N1 in the 2024 and 2025 surveillance years met the predefined threshold. HI antibody reactivity varied across subtypes, surveillance locations, and years among occupationally exposed participants around Poyang Lake. The H3N8 finding in Nanchang and the H10N3 finding in Jiujiang in the 2024 surveillance year warrant further investigation. H5N6 peaks in Jiujiang in 2021 and in Nanchang in 2022; H9N2 peaks in 2021 in Jiujiang and 2023 in Nanchang. HI reactivity alone does not establish subtype-specific human infection or local virus circulation. Continued serological surveillance, interpreted alongside poultry and environmental virological data, may inform risk assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 一种名为禽流感的病毒在江西省的阳性率高达82.3%,这凸显了该地区可能是禽流感病毒传播的潜在热点。作为候鸟迁徙的重要枢纽,以及野生鸟类、家禽和人类频繁接触的区域,鄱阳湖为禽流感病毒跨物种溢出提供了有利的生态条件。本研究旨在描述2018年至2025年间,在鄱阳湖周边职业暴露人群中针对选定的禽流感病毒亚型的抗体血清流行率,并提供数据以支持正在进行的监测和风险评估。在2018年至2025年冬季和春季,每年在江西省南昌县(南昌)以及都昌县和武宁县(九江)开展了一项横断面血清学监测。从职业暴露个体(包括散养家禽的饲养者及其家庭成员、以及直接接触家禽的活禽市场工作人员)中收集了血清样本。国家流感中心通过血凝抑制试验(HI)评估了针对H5N6、H9N2、H7N9、H3N8、H10N3、H5N8和H5N1等病毒抗原的抗体反应。预定义的HI阳性阈值为:H3N8、H5N8、H5N1、H7N9和H10N3 ≥ 1:20,H5N6和H9N2 ≥ 1:40。共分析了2,437份有效血清样本(九江1,599份,南昌838份)。总体而言,108份样本(4.43%)达到H5N6的预定义HI阳性阈值,107份(4.39%)达到H9N2的预定义HI阳性阈值。在2018–2020年期间,914份样本中有25份(2.74%)达到H7N9的预定义HI阳性阈值。在2021–2025年期间,1,523份样本中有22份(1.44%)达到H3N8的预定义HI阳性阈值,其中包括2024年监测期间在南昌收集的100份样本中的9份(9.00%)。在2024年监测期间,1,523份样本中有4份(0.26%)达到H10N3的预定义HI阳性阈值,这4份样本均来自九江。在2020年,314份样本中有4份(1.27%)达到H5N8的预定义HI阳性阈值。在2024和2025年对H5N1进行的检测中,600份样本均未达到预定义的HI阳性阈值。职业暴露人群在鄱阳湖周边对不同亚型的HI抗体反应存在差异,且在不同地点和年份也有所不同。2024年监测期间南昌发现的H3N8和九江发现的H10N3需要进一步研究。H5N6在九江于2021年达到高峰,在南昌于2022年达到高峰;H9N2在九江于2021年达到高峰,在南昌于2023年达到高峰。仅凭HI抗体反应无法确定特定亚型的人类感染或当地病毒传播。持续的血清学监测,结合家禽和环境的病毒学数据,可能有助于风险评估。

papers.title: A review of fractional calculus models for avian influenza: Dynamics, memory effects, and control perspectives
papers.abstract: Avian influenza is a serious global public health threat, and both humans and animals can be infected. Classical integer-order compartmental models are generally not capable of capturing the complex temporal dynamics of epidemic systems, especially memory-dependent phenomena such as delayed immune response and environmental virus persistence. In this review, we have surveyed the use of fractional calculus in the modeling of avian influenza epidemics with emphasis on disease transmission, memory effects, and intervention strategies. In detail, we consider four fractional operators, namely, the Caputo, Caputo-Fabrizio, Atangana-Baleanu, and fractal-fractional operators, and compare the structures of their kernels and their memory properties. We review progress in data-driven modeling, including calibration to real epidemic surveillance data, seasonal transmission patterns, and fractional optimal control formulations in a One Health framework. Based on the review of 16 studies combining fractional calculus with avian influenza or influenza transmission modeling, consistent evidence is provided that fractional-order models reproduce the real outbreak dynamics better than the classical ones. As far as surveillance data is concerned, the Atangana-Baleanu-Caputo operator yields the fewest prediction errors. Key research gaps are identified, and future directions are proposed, including hybrid fractional-machine learning frameworks for real-time adaptive forecasting.
papers.journal: An International Journal of Optimization and Control: Theories & Applications (IJOCTA)

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on avian influenza A viruses and their implications for public health. It highlights the limitations of classical integer-order compartmental models in capturing the complex temporal dynamics of avian influenza outbreaks, particularly memory-dependent phenomena. The review emphasizes the use of fractional calculus in modeling avian influenza, with a focus on disease transmission, memory effects, and intervention strategies. It evaluates four fractional operators and their memory properties, noting that the Atangana-Baleanu-Caputo operator yields the fewest prediction errors in surveillance data. The review also identifies key research gaps, such as the need for hybrid fractional-machine learning frameworks for real-time adaptive forecasting. Overall, the findings suggest that fractional-order models offer improved accuracy in representing avian influenza dynamics compared to traditional models.

In this review, we have surveyed the use of fractional calculus in the modeling of avian influenza epidemics with emphasis on disease transmission, memory effects, and intervention strategies. In detail, we consider four fractional operators, namely, the Caputo, Caputo-Fabrizio, Atangana-Baleanu, and fractal-fractional operators, and compare the structures of their kernels and their memory properties. We review progress in data-driven modeling, including calibration to real epidemic surveillance data, seasonal transmission patterns, and fractional optimal control formulations in a One Health framework. Based on the review of 16 studies combining fractional calculus with avian influenza or influenza transmission modeling, consistent evidence is provided that fractional-order models reproduce the real outbreak dynamics better than the classical ones. As far as surveillance data is concerned, the Atangana-Baleanu-Caputo operator yields the fewest prediction errors. Key research gaps are identified, and future directions are proposed, including hybrid fractional-machine learning frameworks for real-time adaptive forecasting.
papers.abstract_zh: 禽流感是一种严重的全球公共卫生威胁,人类和动物都可能被感染。经典的整数阶分室模型通常无法捕捉疫情系统中复杂的时序动力学,特别是诸如延迟免疫应答和环境病毒持续性等记忆依赖现象。在本综述中,我们重点调查了分数阶微积分在禽流感疫情建模中的应用,特别关注疾病传播、记忆效应以及干预策略。具体而言,我们考虑了四种分数阶算子,即Caputo算子、Caputo-Fabrizio算子、Atangana-Baleanu算子以及分形分数阶算子,并比较了它们核函数的结构及其记忆特性。我们回顾了数据驱动建模的进展,包括对真实疫情监测数据的校准、季节性传播模式以及在One Health框架下的分数阶最优控制公式。基于对16项结合分数阶微积分与禽流感或流感传播建模研究的综述,提供了一致的证据表明分数阶模型比经典模型更能准确再现真实暴发的动力学。就监测数据而言,Atangana-Baleanu-Caputo算子产生的预测误差最少。识别了关键的研究空白,并提出了未来的研究方向,包括用于实时自适应预测的混合分数阶-机器学习框架。

papers.title: ARGUS: A Four-Signal Joint Model for H5N1 Neuraminidase Inhibitor Resistance Prediction
papers.abstract: Oseltamivir and zanamivir are the primary antivirals against H5N1 influenza, yet resistance profiles at the structural level remain incompletely characterized. Phenotypic screening requires one to two weeks in biosafety level 3 containment; during an active spillover event, this timescale is incompatible with clinical decisions. We present ARGUS (Affinity-and Representation-Guided Unified Scoring), a learned joint model combining four independent structural signals into a unified resistance risk framework: molecular docking affinity, protein language model evolutionary likelihood, perturbation response scanning, and all-atom pocket volume analysis. This work comprises two major components: (1) a comprehensive dual-drug saturation mutagenesis of the H5N1 neuraminidase binding pocket (1,102 mutations, 551 per drug) revealing a striking 166:1 asymmetry between oseltamivir-specific and zanamivir-specific resistance mutations, reflecting zanamivir’s substrate-mimicking pharmacophore; and (2) a novel four-signal learned joint model validated against 37 published fold-resistance measurements spanning H5N1, H1N1pdm09, H3N2, and H7N9 backgrounds (oseltamivir fold-resistance was the fitting target). The four-signal model achieves leave-one-out Spearman ρ = 0.628 (p = 0.000032), with a 95% bootstrap interval of [0.428, 0.845] for the in-sample correlation and a permutation p < 0.001. The earlier two-signal linear blend reached ρ = 0.659 (p = 0.0142) on only n=8 mutations, so the two figures are not directly comparable. The learned weights make docking the dominant signal (96.3% of the total weight) with ESM-2 LLR at 3.7%, which fits the view that protein language models alone conflate evolutionary constraint with drug-resistance specificity. Applied to the 2024 US H5N1 B3.13 outbreak, all 21 outbreak mutations are pocket-distal for both drugs, predicting maintained efficacy of both antivirals. ARGUS provides immediate structural assessment of any novel neuraminidase mutation without experimental work, and the full saturation landscape and trained models are released as a public resource on Zenodo.

source_records.abstract: Oseltamivir and zanamivir are the primary antivirals against H5N1 influenza, yet resistance profiles at the structural level remain incompletely characterized. Phenotypic screening requires one to two weeks in biosafety level 3 containment; during an active spillover event, this timescale is incompatible with clinical decisions. papers.title: Pathogenesis and Cross-species Potential of Emerging H3N3 Influenza Viruses with Mammalian-adaptive Mutations
papers.abstract: The emergence of triple-reassortant H3N3 avian influenza viruses (AIVs) poses a threat to poultry and public health.This study characterized three novel H3N3 isolates (SQ2049, HN0120, and GT2125) from chickens in China, evaluating their evolution, pathogenicity, and vaccine efficacy.Phylogenetic analysis revealed these isolates originated from H10N3 and H3N8 lineages, carrying an H9N2-derived internal gene backbone.Although identified as low pathogenic AIVs (IVPI=0), they exhibited distinct replicative fitness.GT2125 showed reduced efficiency in embryos, and carried unique PB2 substitutions (V598I and K702).Pathogenicity trials in SPF chickens demonstrated that SQ2049 achieves efficient horizontal transmission in SPF chickens without clinical signs.Notably, cloacal viral shedding persisted for 11 days, whereas oral viral shedding only lasted 2 to 3 day, with mild histopathological lesions observed in the trachea and immune organs.Importantly, the inactivated SQ2049 vaccine elicited high cross-reactive antibody titers (HI≥8log2) and provided 100% protection in SPF chickens.Mouse infection studies identified two HA substitutions (G174E and N209D) after viral replication in mice.These two mutations have previously been associated with mammalian adaptation and enhanced binding to human-type α-2,6 receptors, though their functional effects in the H3N3 context were not evaluated in this study.These findings expand our understanding of H3N3 AIV evolutionary dynamics and highlight the importance of surveillance for reassortant influenza viruses.The demonstrated vaccine efficacy provides a foundation for future H3N3 prevention and control strategies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate the evolution, pathogenicity, and vaccine efficacy of emerging H3N3 avian influenza viruses with mammalian-adaptive mutations, as their emergence poses a threat to poultry and public health.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study characterized three novel H3N3 isolates (SQ2049, HN0120, and GT2125) from chickens in China, assessing their replicative fitness and pathogenicity in SPF chickens.
analysis.methods: Phylogenetic analysis was used to determine the origin of the isolates, and pathogenicity trials in SPF chickens evaluated their replication and shedding patterns. Additionally, mouse infection studies were conducted to identify HA substitutions associated with mammalian adaptation.
analysis.main_results: SQ2049 demonstrated efficient horizontal transmission in SPF chickens without clinical signs, with cloacal viral shedding persisting for 11 days and oral shedding lasting only 2 to 3 days. The inactivated SQ2049 vaccine elicited high cross-reactive antibody titers (HI≥8log2) and provided 100% protection in SPF chickens. GT2125 showed reduced efficiency in embryos and carried unique PB2 substitutions (V598I and K702).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings expand our understanding of H3N3 AIV evolutionary dynamics and highlight the importance of surveillance for reassortant influenza viruses, as the HA substitutions identified have previously been associated with mammalian adaptation and enhanced binding to human-type α-2,6 receptors.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The demonstrated vaccine efficacy provides a foundation for future H3N3 prevention and control strategies, and the study underscores the need for continued monitoring of avian influenza viruses with potential zoonotic capabilities.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to SPF chickens and mouse models, which may not fully represent natural host interactions. The evidence is moderate, as the functional effects of the HA substitutions in the H3N3 context were not evaluated.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the emergence of triple-reassortant H3N3 avian influenza viruses (AIVs) in China, focusing on their evolution, pathogenicity, and vaccine efficacy. Three novel isolates (SQ2049, HN0120, and GT2125) were characterized, revealing their origin from H10N3 and H3N8 lineages with an H9N2-derived internal gene backbone. SQ2049 showed efficient horizontal transmission in SPF chickens without clinical signs, with prolonged cloacal shedding and mild histopathological lesions. The inactivated SQ2049 vaccine elicited high cross-reactive antibody titers and provided complete protection. GT2125 exhibited reduced embryonic efficiency and unique PB2 substitutions. Mouse infection studies identified HA mutations linked to mammalian adaptation, though their functional effects in H3N3 were not assessed. These findings contribute to understanding H3N3 AIV dynamics and emphasize the importance of surveillance for reassortant viruses. The study highlights the potential for vaccine development against H3N3 AIVs but is limited to controlled models, suggesting moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估具有哺乳动物适应性突变的新兴H3N3 禽流感病毒的进化、致病性和疫苗效果,因为它们的出现对家禽和公共卫生构成威胁。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究对中国鸡群中分离的三种新型H3N3病毒株(SQ2049、HN0120和GT2125)进行了表征,评估了它们在SPF鸡中的复制适应性和致病性。
elements_zh.methods: 使用系统发育分析来确定病毒株的起源,并通过SPF鸡的致病性试验评估其复制和排毒模式。此外,还进行了小鼠感染研究以识别与哺乳动物适应性相关的HA突变。
elements_zh.main_results: SQ2049在无临床症状的情况下在SPF鸡中实现了高效的水平传播,肛门病毒排毒持续了11天,而口腔排毒仅持续2至3天。灭活的SQ2049 疫苗引发了高交叉反应抗体滴度(HI≥8log2)并在SPF鸡中提供了100%的保护效果。GT2125在胚胎中表现出较低的效率,并携带独特的PB2突变(V598I和K702)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现扩展了我们对H3N3 AIV进化动态的理解,并强调了监测对于重配流感病毒的重要性,因为所识别的HA突变此前曾与哺乳动物适应性和增强对人类型α-2,6受体的结合能力相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 所展示的疫苗效果为未来H3N3的预防和控制策略奠定了基础,同时本研究强调了对具有潜在人兽共患病能力的禽流感病毒进行持续监测的必要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于SPF鸡和小鼠模型,这可能无法完全代表自然宿主相互作用。证据强度中等,因为未评估HA突变在H3N3背景下的功能效应。
